answer: Each identity must forge one tax receipt per epoch, file it on the marble ledger, and burn 45 credits, with 60 credits bonded. A comet sweep audits 5% of receipts per epoch and replays the marble ledger: a fake or rented receipt burns the bond, voiding it. To forge 1,000 identities costs 45,000 per epoch plus 60,000 locked, against a 40,000 pool: a loss of 5,000 per epoch before audit burns. An honest agent files once, pays 45, keeps its share.
